rightsNote: Each selected source caption and the JPL image-use policy were checked individually. Thirteen images credit NASA/JPL; the four JIRAM/VIMS images preserve their full NASA/JPL-Caltech/SwRI/ASI/INAF/JIRAM or University of Arizona team credits. The selected JPL captions contain no separate copyright ownership or restricted-use notice; reuse relies on JPL's permission for unrestricted images, not a blanket public-domain assertion about NASA-hosted content. Attribution and no endorsement are required. Human review and future store/commercial branding review remain pending; logos, likenesses and independently owned content require separate handling.
processing: Downloaded JPEG bytes; no local cropping, recoloring, compositing or upscaling. PIA01384, PIA24967 and PIA09188 use NASA's own proportional 1280-pixel variants to reduce decode memory; other files are original JPEG downloads. NASA's filter/color processing and PIA22336's official computer-generated infrared data visualization are explained per image in the catalog.
